counter_rule: Every raw and per-phase independent actual_execution_independently_derived is the SAME exact42-key int>=0 dictionary. No expected-fill, bool-as-dict, alias fallback or joint nested-shape guessing. Format validation preserves honest over-cap and completion-greater-than-attempt observations; separate counter_policy_violations records those failures and forces rejected acceptance while retaining the actual dictionary.
